name: Kimberly Oleiro
headline: Helping DTC brands grow through CRO, Email, SEO & Shopify Dev | ex-Shopify PM
about:
I'm a dynamic and adaptable Product Manager with a background in software development and entrepreneurship. 

Experienced in diverse environments, from a 12-person startup to building scalable products for 3 million Shopify shops, I use my broad skills, creativity, and organization to make an impact. 

My approach is straightforward: deeply understand people and solve their problems, creating solutions that both empower and delight.

Outside work, you’ll find me PM’ing various areas of my life from health and fitness to travel and finance. My love for travel is matched only by my passion for a well-organized spreadsheet. 

I'm curious about the products and ideas that excite you. Let's connect!
… more

experiences.description:
Helping early-stage and scaling brands launch faster and grow smarter on Shopify. What began as a dev-focused studio has evolved into a strategic consultancy—combining UX, product thinking, and growth execution under one roof.

Recent Focus (2024–Present):
- Consulting, strategy, and actionable roadmaps across CRO, SEO, and Email Automation
- End-to-end execution through high-impact Shopify design, development, and optimization

Foundation (2021–2023):
- Delivered 13+ custom websites across Shopify, Webflow, and Squarespace for fashion, beauty, and wellness brands
- Led full project cycles—from scoping and content modeling to front-end development and QA
- Built fast, mobile-friendly storefronts focused on UX, performance, and merchant independence
- Grew Early Riser’s audience to 1,300+ followers in year one through content, branding, and experimentation

Advanced Customization & Developer Tooling, Storefronts

- Currently leading a team in developing tools and architecture for Shopify’s theme and app developers, ranging from CLI to Theme App Extensions, supporting the platform's expansive ecosystem

Theme Design & Customization, Storefronts

- Led a team that generated $21B in GMV, impacting 1.5 million shops, through Shopify’s free theme catalog.
- Shipped 4 major releases to the design system, introducing advanced features and customization options to enhance merchant brand differentiation and drive conversions.
- Successfully launched 2 themes with 184,729 collective installs.
- Pioneered a vision for no-code to low-code themes powered by Liquid, aligning with modern e-commerce trends.

- Led team initiatives, contributing to 3.5 million global ticket sales and capturing significant market share in the Attractions segment.
- Redesigned a calendar widget for the Attractions segment, cutting checkout drop-offs by 70% and markedly improving user experience.
- Managed a cross-functional team of six, navigating a high-growth environment to deliver impactful product enhancements.
Developed event landing pages using JavaScript and React for a world-class ticketing platform.
Developed and maintained two critical systems: the real-time communication studio app (built with React, Redux, and WebRTC) and the subscription-based payment system (created with Node and Stripe).

Assisting instructors in a variety of workshops including HTML, CSS, Javascript and Data Analytics. Encourage students to feel enthusiastic, excited and confident about building their technology skills.
